subject: Intermittent 429s — investigation, evidence bundle, and remediation plan
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@finsight.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Intermittent 429s since Aug 18 — examples attached

Hi Aditya,

We started seeing intermittent 429s yesterday evening (PDT) across a subset of our batch ingestion jobs. The pattern is odd — spikes every ~10 minutes, lasting 30–90s, then clearing. We tried throttling our client side and that didn't help.

I'm attaching a small sample of request/response pairs and timestamps (429-sample-logs.txt). Can you confirm if this is on your side or if we should continue debugging our retry logic? This is impacting our nightly scoring pipeline.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Martinez
Head of Platform, FinSight Analytics
elena@finsight.ai

Attachment: 429-sample-logs.txt (text, 48KB)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Elena Martinez <elena@finsight.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 429s since Aug 18 — examples attached

Elena — thanks for the sample logs and the clear timeline. We're looking into this now. Quick notes:

- We see correlated 429s in our observability for tenant "finsight-prod" matching your timestamps.
- Initial triage suggests a quota-routing anomaly rather than client-side retries.

Can you confirm whether you have any sub-tenant / project-level tokens (e.g., projectA, projectB) under the same account that started heavy parallelization yesterday? If so, please list the token prefixes.

We'll gather request traces and a bundle for you within the next 4 hours. If this is causing production impact, we'll prioritize an immediate fix.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Please share your traces when available. We're standing by and can open a maintenance window tonight if you need to run changes.

—Elena

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 01:23:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: quick RCA and mitigation proposal (do not send)

On Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:02 AM aditya_rao@redwood.ai wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the sample logs and the clear timeline. We're looking into this now.

Team — summary of findings from infra trace:

1) Root cause: a configuration drift in the quota-mapping table deployed 2026-08-18 02:17 UTC. The helm rollout accidentally merged an older default-cap rule that caused tokens with prefix ING- to be mapped to the account-level default cap (very low burst window) instead of their intended project cap.

2) Impact: produced periodic 429s for parallelized flows (exactly the 10-minute cadence due to our enforcement window aggregation). Affected tenant: finsight-prod (project-ingest / project-transform).

3) Evidence bundle: quota-map-diff.patch (showing the delta), annotated flux audit logs, and a sample of the 429 responses we pulled.

Mitigation we can do immediately (30–90m):
- Hotfix: push a targeted quota-map patch to correct prefix rules to point to the project caps (patch attached).
- Temporary lift: increase default-cap for finsight-prod to a safe emergency level while the patch rolls out and stabilizes.
- Postmortem items: automate helm preflight to reject deprecated default-cap entries; add canary check on quota mapping during rollouts.

Customer communication draft (to send after we confirm the patch): concise RCA, steps taken, attachments with logs, offer 1-month service credit for SLA disruption, request customer verification window and final acceptance.

Please review and +1 if OK to send to Elena and ops@finsight.ai.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: quota-map-diff.patch, routing-annotated-diagram.png

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Elena Martinez <elena@finsight.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 00:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Action taken: root cause, patch, and next steps

Elena / FinSight ops — short summary and next steps (most important items first):

1) What happened (short): A quota-mapping regression in a recent config rollout caused your ingest token prefix (ING-) to be mapped to the account default cap instead of the project cap. With your increased parallelism this produced short, periodic 429 bursts.

2) What we did (timeline):
- 2026-08-20 03:10 UTC — identified misapplied rule via audit logs and trace correlation.
- 2026-08-20 03:28 UTC — deployed targeted quota-map fix (quota-map-diff.patch) to point ING- and TRN- to their intended project caps.
- 2026-08-20 03:36 UTC — increased temporary emergency default-cap for finsight-prod to avoid residual bursts while the rollout completed.
- 2026-08-20 04:05 UTC — monitored 2 hours; no recurrence in our samples.

3) Attachments delivered: 429-sample-logs.txt, quota-map-diff.patch, routing-annotated-diagram.png (evidence bundle and the exact patch we applied).

4) Remediation & follow-ups:
- We recommend you validate your nightly scoring window tonight and confirm no 429s.
- We'll schedule a 30-minute postmortem call to walk through the patch, audit logs, and our planned rollout safety gates (suggested: Mon 2026-08-23 10:00 PDT).
- Postmortem action items we own: helm preflight validation, canary quota-check on 2x traffic, and a rollback automation for quota-map changes.

5) Customer impact and compensation: We recognize the production impact. We will issue a one-time account credit equivalent to 1 month of hosted inference unit charges for finsight-prod under deal FS-2026-073. Accounting will follow up for formal billing docs.

6) Next steps for FinSight: Please confirm: (a) you received the attachments, (b) you can validate tonight, (c) whether you accept the proposed timeslot for a postmortem call.

Apologies for the disruption. We're treating this as P1 to improve rollout safety and prevent recurrence.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Attachments: 429-sample-logs.txt, quota-map-diff.patch, routing-annotated-diagram.png
